title: Larry and the boy at the French fort, Núi Bà Đen
description: Larry (left), looking down — probably at reports, he says — stands among the granite boulders of the French fort on Núi Bà Đen beside a smiling Vietnamese boy in an oversized field jacket. The boy, about twelve, had been shot in the leg, was married at ten, and had two children; he stayed with Larry all the time. Painted Vietnamese inscriptions cover the rock face; a doorway is built into the mortared stone. Larry's radio was set up outside, and around this time about five Air Force men were installing a radar with a rotating search antenna up in the boulders.
larrysRecollection:
right, he was 12, shot in the leg, he was married at 10. he had two kids. Don't recall his name.
That is me on the left. I was probably looking at some reports. the stone is the french fort, my radio was outside. About 5 Airforce guys were putting in a radar? It had a search antenna that rotated that was built up in the boulders. The kid was with me all the time
